cohort: 400 primigravida patients attending a tertiary care center in West Bengal, divided into two groups: teenage primigravida (13-19 years) and adult primigravida (20-29 years).
finding: Teenage primigravida had significantly higher rates of Cesarean section and maternal complications (anemia, PIH, PPH, pre-eclampsia, eclampsia, APH, and IUGR) compared to adult primigravida.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were significantly higher in teenage primigravida (54%) compared to adult primigravida (19%).
